Put a free calculator on your site

Fotocal's calorie and BMI calculators, ready to copy and paste into your blog or website.

Updated: 8 November 2026 · By Fotocal, Madrid

If you write about nutrition, train people or run a practice, you can put our calculators on your site. They are free, carry no ads or third-party cookies, and what people type never leaves the browser. All we ask is that you keep the credit link underneath.

Daily calorie calculator

Copy this code and paste it into your page (in WordPress, in a "Custom HTML" block):

<iframe src="https://getfotocal.com/en/embed/calorias/" title="Daily calorie calculator" width="100%" height="760" style="border:0;max-width:560px" loading="lazy"></iframe>
<p><a href="https://getfotocal.com/en/calculadoras/calorias-diarias/">Calculator by Fotocal</a></p>

BMI calculator for women and men

Copy this code and paste it into your page (in WordPress, in a "Custom HTML" block):

<iframe src="https://getfotocal.com/en/embed/imc/" title="BMI calculator for women and men" width="100%" height="640" style="border:0;max-width:560px" loading="lazy"></iframe>
<p><a href="https://getfotocal.com/en/calculadoras/imc/">Calculator by Fotocal</a></p>

Terms

  • Free, for personal sites, blogs, gyms and practices.
  • Keep the "Calculator by Fotocal" link visible under the widget.
